<!-- Please read before opening this PR. -->

Thanks for the effort, and sorry to catch you here: **Tifa does not accept pull requests.** One maintainer writes and owns every line, so PRs are closed without review as a matter of policy, not as a judgment on your work.

What works instead:

- **[Open an issue](https://github.com/liustack/tifa/issues/new/choose)** describing the bug or the idea. Issues get read and shape what gets built next. If your branch shows the fix, link it from the issue.
- **Keep it in your fork.** Under MIT your copy is yours.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the whole picture.
